verification.summary: Confirmed live dormant 0015 store, reusable Resolver/stat serializer/parser, synchronous legacy route, absent worker/API/health consumer and the explicit no-frontend-cutover boundary.

risks.detail: The new route may resolve/serialize/enqueue only and tests must fail if it invokes SimC.
Worker re-resolves and signature-compares under a fenced lease before execution/publication.
One child only; candidate records CPU/memory/backend impact before merge.
No frontend call site or Catalyst capability changes are allowed in Slice 5B.

summary: Phase 5B is implementation-allowed for the canonical async API, one-child fenced worker/service and bounded operations only. Frontend traffic remains on the compatible legacy endpoint and Catalyst stays disabled.
